rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for tentatively saying what you think is true.

example.english: I hypothesize that he won’t come for dinner today.
example.traditional: 我估佢今日唔會嚟食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 lai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this when explicitly positing a tentative theory or condition, especially in an academic or analytical context.

example.english: We hypothesize first that this figure was calculated correctly, then continue the analysis.
example.traditional: 我哋先假設呢個數字冇計錯，再繼續分析。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 gaa2 cit3 ni1 go3 sou3 zi6 mou5 gai3 co3 zoi3 gai3 zuk6 fan1 sik1

rows.note: Use this when the tentative idea is an inference based on incomplete evidence rather than a theory being deliberately posited.

example.english: Based on the shoes at the door, I hypothesize that they have already gone home.
example.traditional: 睇住門口對鞋，我推測佢已經返咗屋企。
example.jyutping: tai2 zyu6 mun4 hau2 deoi3 haai4 ngo5 teoi1 cak1 keoi5 ji5 ging1 faan2 zo2 uk1 kei2
